Objectives and description: This WP involves conducting systemic literature reviews to conceptualise further groundwork for the research, identify key themes, and substantiate research gaps and consulting stakeholders to verify theoretical findings. Methods: the comperative content and thematic analyses of literature and policy
documents, and stakeholder consultations through interviews or focus groups.
Tasks:
T2.1. Conduct a comprehensive systematic literature review on IM, environmental sustainability and sustainable open innovation.
T2.2. Identify and engage relevant stakeholders through interviews or focus groups.
Deliverables:
D2.1. One report in international conference.
D2.2. Literature review with key findings and synthesized results in the scientific publication (in SCOPUS, Q1/Q2)

dataset.description:
Objectives and description: This WP ensures effective coordination, monitoring and impact assessment of project activities to achieve the research aim within the specified timeframe. Methods: Project management methodologies will be employed to ensure efficient coordination and oversight of project activities.
Tasks:
T1.1. Establish project management structure and communication procedures.
T1.2. Develop a detailed project plan with timelines and milestones.
T1.3. Allocate resources and responsibilities among the research team.
T1.4. Monitor project progress, address any deviations from the plan and assess the impact of the project.
T1.5. Establish an international scientific committee to oversee the scientific direction of the project.
Deliverables (expected results):
D1.1. Project management plan;
D1.2. Implementation (final) report on achievements and impact of the project

dataset.description:
Objectives and description: this WP focuses on disseminating research findings to relevant stakeholders and ensuring their visibility and impact. It involves preparing briefs of research findings, organizing dissemination events, sharing results with the broader community. Methods: Dissemination activities will utilize various communication channels, including conferences, workshops, and other events, media and digital platforms to reach diverse audiences and maximize impact.
Tasks:
T6.1. Prepare briefs, press releases and info on key findings and recommendations.
T6.2. Organize or participate in workshops, conferences and other dissemination events.
T6.3. Attract and collaborate with potential project partners to prepare and submit a new research project.
T6.4. Produce a podcast to disseminate research findings.
Deliverables:
D6.1. Dissemination materials (e.g.presentations).
D6.2. Participation in dissemination events to engage with relevant stakeholders.
D6.3. Information in the websites and social media of partners to enhance visibility of the project and outreach efforts. D6.4. Podcast series consisting of 3 episodes on research findings.

Objectives and description: This WP involves collecting primary and secondary data, analyzing data using quantitative and qualitative methods based on the developed methodology, and interpreting findings. Methods: Data collection methods will include survey, interviews, and data mining techniques. Statistical analysis and modeling will be used to analyze quantitative data, while thematic analysis will be applied to qualitative data.
Tasks:
T4.1. Conduct survey and interviews with experts.
T4.2. Collect secondary data from relevant sources.
T4.3. Statistical analysis and modeling of data.
T4.4. To prepare and submit research article.
Deliverables:
D4.1. The data set for an empirical research.
D4.2. One report in international conference.
D4.3. Digital material on the sustainable IM practices for relevant practicioners.
D4.4. Key empirical research findings on the sustainable idea management methods published in the scientific publication (in SCOPUS, Q1/Q2).

Objectives and description: This WP will synthesize the research findings into future research directions, practical implications and recommendations to other relevant stakeholders identifying trends, and formulating evidence-based recommendations to address challenges and leverage opportunities. Methods: the qualitative and quantitative analysis to distill key findings from the research data. Stakeholder consultations will provide valuable input and ensure that recommendations are practical and feasible for implementation.
Tasks:
T5.1. Analyze research findings to identify key trends.
T5.2. Consult with stakeholders to validate research findings.
T5.3. Formulate evidence-based recommendations for relevant stakeholders.
T5.4. To summarise results and prepare the research (project) concept summarising recommendations on practical implications, actionable insights and further strategies. T5.5. Objectives and description: This WP focuses on developing the research methodology tailored to the topic of this research and designing data collection instruments, refining analytical frameworks, and identifying appropriate research (data analyses) tools. Methods: a combination of quantitative techniques (e.g., econometric modeling) and qualitative methods (e.g., thematic analysis, clustering).
Tasks:
T3.1. Design data collection instruments, including surveys and interview protocols.
T3.2. Develop statistical/econometric models and analytical frameworks.
T3.3. Acquire necessary research/ analytical tools and data sources.
Deliverables:
D3.1. Methodology for the data collection and analyles of the empirical reserach;
D3.2. Survey questionnaire and interview guidelines.
